n: I sekai de, otto no ai wa omoikedo kawaii kodomo o honobono tanoshiku sodatetai ~ akuyaku ōjo, shiawase rūto mezashimasu ~
In another world, my husband's love is intense, but I want to raise my cute children in a warm and happy way ~The villainous princess aims for the happy route~
異世界で、夫の愛は重いけど可愛い子どもをほのぼの楽しく育てたい ～悪役王女、幸せルート目指します～
